description: This file implements functionality for managing a whitelist of origin-domain pairs for CORS in a WebKit extension, including parsing JSON data into internal structures and adding whitelist entries to WebKit.

classes.name: JSONEntry
classes.description: Represents a JSON object containing origin, domain list, and subdomain flag for whitelist entries.

methods.name: ParseWhiteList
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to populate the whitelist map with origin-domain pairs.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::Parse
methods.description: Creates a whitelist object from a JSON string.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the stored whitelist entries to a WebKit extension.
